scientific_integrity: The claimed new statement is a constructed lower obstruction and the exact fixed-a=2 boundary; it does not claim independent validation or novelty of CRT/PNT.
scientific_limitations: The theta-asymptotic invokes the prime number theorem; optimality of the lower constant is not shown. The 2026 paper traces related investigations to a public 2023 dissertation, which was available by abstract but not accessible in full for the present novelty comparison.
title: Logarithmic lower growth of primitive Frobenius thresholds and a sharp boundary at two
